        a1 = cal.last_business_day_of_week(today, 1)
    prods = read_list(vars, "products", "get_account_response.data.products", "fetch_account_response.data.products")
    plan = []
    for i, p in enumerate(prods):
        t = str(p.get("type") or "")
        if t == "credit_card":
            name = "credit card ending " + str(p.get("card_last4") or "")
            floor = p.get("minimum_payment")
        elif t == "car_loan":
            name = "car loan"
            floor = p.get("instalment_amount")
        else:
            name = "personal loan"
            floor = p.get("instalment_amount")
        dl_ = int(p.get("days_late") or 0)
        band = RULES["bands"][0] if dl_ <= RULES["bands"][0]["hi"] else RULES["bands"][1]
        dl = cal.add_business_days(today, band["bd"])
        plan.append(dict(n=i + 1, id=str(p.get("product_id") or ""), name=name, due=float(p.get("past_due") or 0),
                         days=dl_, band=band["name"], att=band["attempts"], floor=float(floor or 0), deadline=dl))
    facts = []
    stm = []
    for p in plan:
        s = ("PRODUCT " + str(p["n"]) + ": " + p["name"] + " (product_id " + p["id"] + "). Past due " + money(p["due"]) +
             ", " + str(p["days"]) + " days late, band " + p["band"] + ". Floor (lowest amount allowed) " + money(p["floor"]) +
             ". Deadline: " + spoken(p["deadline"]) + " (" + p["deadline"].isoformat() + "), promise date on or before it. " +
             "Persuasion attempts for this product: " + str(p["att"]) + ". Attempt 1: full " + money(p["due"]) +
             " (or the floor " + money(p["floor"]) + " if the customer already said the full amount is too much) on " +
             spoken(a1) + " (" + a1.isoformat() + ").")
        if p["att"] >= 2:
            s += " Attempt 2: the floor " + money(p["floor"]) + " on the deadline " + spoken(p["deadline"]) + " (" + p["deadline"].isoformat() + ")."
        else:
            s += " There is NO attempt 2 for this product."
        facts.append(s)
        stm.append("Your " + p["name"] + " has a past-due amount of " + money(p["due"]) + " and is " + str(p["days"]) + " days late.")
    if plan:
        vars["account_facts"] = "\n".join(facts)
        vars["debt_statement"] = ("I am calling from the collections team about late payments. " + " ".join(stm) +
                                  (" Can you make all of these payments today?" if len(plan) > 1 else " Can you make this payment today?"))
        latest = max(p["deadline"] for p in plan)

        def answer(d):
            parts = []
            for p in plan:
                lab = "product " + str(p["n"])
                if d < today:
                    parts.append(lab + ": in the past, ask for another day")
                elif d > p["deadline"]:
                    parts.append(lab + ": AFTER its deadline, say the latest date you can record is " + spoken(p["deadline"]) + " and use " + p["deadline"].isoformat())
                elif not cal.is_business_day(d):
                    nd = cal.next_business_day(d)
                    if nd > p["deadline"]:
                        parts.append(lab + ": not a business day, offer the deadline " + spoken(p["deadline"]) + " (" + p["deadline"].isoformat() + ")")
                    else:
                        parts.append(lab + ": not a business day, offer " + spoken(nd) + " (" + nd.isoformat() + ")")
                else:
                    parts.append(lab + ": accept " + d.isoformat())
            return "; ".join(parts)
        vars["date_answers"] = answer_table(cal, today, (latest - today).days + 10, answer)
    else:
        vars["account_facts"] = "The account details are not available."
        vars["debt_statement"] = "I am calling from the collections team about a late payment, but I cannot see the account details right now."
        vars["date_answers"] = "Not available."
except Exception as e:

    vars["debt_statement"] = "I am calling from the collections team about a late payment, but I cannot see the account details right now."
    vars["date_answers"] = "Not available."

            floor = p.get("instalment_amount")
        dl_ = int(float(p.get("days_late") or 0))
        band = RULES["bands"][0] if dl_ <= RULES["bands"][0]["hi"] else RULES["bands"][1]
        deadline = cal.add_business_days(today, band["bdays"])
        a1 = min(lbw, deadline)
        plan.append(dict(id=str(p.get("product_id") or ("p" + str(i + 1))), label=label, due=money(p.get("past_due")),
                         days=dl_, band=band["name"], attempts=band["attempts"], floor=money(floor),
                         deadline=deadline, a1=a1))
    if not plan:
        raise ValueError("no products")
    fl = []
    for n, p in enumerate(plan):
        s = ("PRODUCT %d: product_id=%s, say \"%s\". Full past-due amount %s, %d days late, band %s. Floor (lowest amount allowed) %s. "
             "DEADLINE (latest promise date, on or before): %s (%s). Persuasion attempts allowed: %d. "
             % (n + 1, p["id"], p["label"], p["due"], p["days"], p["band"], p["floor"], spoken(p["deadline"]), p["deadline"].isoformat(), p["attempts"]))
        s += ("Attempt 1: %s (or %s if the customer already said the full amount is too much) on %s (%s). "
              % (p["due"], p["floor"], spoken(p["a1"]), p["a1"].isoformat()))
        if p["attempts"] >= 2:
            s += "Attempt 2: the floor %s on the deadline %s (%s). " % (p["floor"], spoken(p["deadline"]), p["deadline"].isoformat())
        else:
            s += "There is NO attempt 2 for this product. "
        fl.append(s)
    vars["account_facts"] = "\n".join(fl)
    parts = []
    for p in plan:
        parts.append("Your %s has %s past due and is %d days late." % (p["label"], p["due"], p["days"]))
    if len(plan) == 1:
        q = "Can you make this payment today?"
    else:
        q = "Can you pay all of them today?"
    vars["debt_statement"] = "Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment. " + " ".join(parts) + " " + q
    latest = max(p["deadline"] for p in plan)
    ws = cal.week_start(today)
    names = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"]
    wk = []
    for k in range(7):
        a = ws + _dt.timedelta(days=k)
        b = ws + _dt.timedelta(days=7 + k)
        wk.append("\"this %s\" = %s (%s); \"next %s\" = %s (%s)" % (names[k], spoken(a), a.isoformat(), names[k], spoken(b), b.isoformat()))

    def answer(d):
        out = []
        for p in plan:
            if d < today:
                out.append(p["id"] + ": in the past, cannot be recorded, ask for another day")
            elif d > p["deadline"]:
                out.append(p["id"] + ": AFTER its deadline; the latest date you can record is " + spoken(p["deadline"]) + " (" + p["deadline"].isoformat() + "), offer it; if this day was named for all products, use that deadline for " + p["id"] + " and say so in the read-back")
            elif not cal.is_business_day(d):
                nd = cal.next_business_day(d)
                out.append(p["id"] + ": not a business day, offer " + spoken(nd) + " (" + nd.isoformat() + ")")
            else:
                out.append(p["id"] + ": accept " + d.isoformat())
        return "; ".join(out)
    vars["date_answers"] = ("Today is " + spoken(today) + " (" + today.isoformat() + ").\n" + "\n".join(wk) + "\n"
                            + answer_table(cal, today, (latest - today).days + 10, answer))
except Exception as e:
    vars["account_facts"] = "The account details could not be read. Say that you do not have the account details right now, thank the customer and close the call as no_promise with reason service_error."
    vars["debt_statement"] = "Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment, but I cannot read the account details right now."
    vars["date_answers"] = "Not available."

7	## Tool function shape
8	
9	Every external action is a **tool function**. The shape is the same wherever you attach it.
10	
11	```json
12	{
13	  "type": "function",
14	  "config": { "timeoutMs": 10000, "maxRetries": 2 },
15	  "function": {
16	    "name": "lookup_order",
17	    "handler": "__function__:api_call",
18	    "description": "Look up one order. CALL it when the caller asks about a specific order.",
19	    "parameters": {
20	      "type": "object",
21	      "properties": {
22	        "url": { "type": "string", "default": "https://api.example.com/v1/orders/lookup" },
23	        "method": { "type": "string", "default": "POST" },
24	        "headers": {
25	          "type": "object",
26	          "properties": { "Content-Type": { "type": "string", "default": "application/json" } }
27	        },
28	        "body": {
29	          "type": "object",
30	          "properties": {
31	            "customer_id": { "type": "string", "default": "{{customer_id}}" },
32	            "order_number": { "type": "string", "description": "Order number, digits only", "default": "{{order_number}}" }
33	          },
34	          "required": ["order_number"]
35	        }
36	      }
37	    }
38	  },
39	  "response_mapping": [
40	    { "path": "data.status", "variable": "order_status" }
41	  ]
42	}
43	```
44	
45	| Field | Meaning |
46	|---|---|
47	| `type` | Always `"function"` |
48	| `function.name` | Tool name. The model calls it by this name. Result variables are named after it |
49	| `function.handler` | Which runtime executes the tool. See the table below |
50	| `function.description` | Read by the dialogue model when the tool is in `tools`. Ignored in `pre_actions` |
51	| `function.parameters` | JSON-schema object. `properties` holds the parameters |
52	| `config.timeoutMs` | Timeout of one attempt, in milliseconds |
53	| `config.maxRetries` | Tool-level retries of a failed call |
54	| `config.interruptible` | `false` makes the tool run in the background. See "Background tools" |
55	| `config.alwaysRunsAt` | Makes the tool a lifecycle tool. See "Lifecycle tools" |
56	| `response_mapping` | Tool level, for tools in `tools`. Maps the result to variables |
57	| `pre_process_code` | Python hook that runs before the call |
58	| `post_process_code` | Python hook that runs after the call |
59	
60	| Handler | Runs |
61	|---|---|
62	| `__function__:api_call` | An HTTP request |
63	| `__function__:code_exec` | A Python snippet in a sandbox |
64	| `__function__:end_call` | Hangs up. Used in the `terminal` of an `end_call` node |
65	
66	Handlers for integrations, knowledge search, call transfer and rescheduling also exist. They are not needed here.
67	
68	`api_call` parameters:
69	
70	| Parameter | Meaning |
71	|---|---|
72	| `url` | Request URL. `{{var}}` works |
73	| `method` | HTTP method |
74	| `headers` | Object. Each header is a property with a `default` |
75	| `body` | Object. Each body field is a property under `body.properties` |
76	| `connect_retries` | Transport retries. See "Retries and timeouts" |

## Tool function shape

Every external action is a **tool function**. The shape is the same wherever you attach it.

```json
{
  "type": "function",
  "config": { "timeoutMs": 10000, "maxRetries": 2 },
  "function": {
    "name": "lookup_order",
    "handler": "__function__:api_call",
    "description": "Look up one order. CALL it when the caller asks about a specific order.",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "url": { "type": "string", "default": "https://api.example.com/v1/orders/lookup" },
        "method": { "type": "string", "default": "POST" },
        "headers": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": { "Content-Type": { "type": "string", "default": "application/json" } }
        },
        "body": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "customer_id": { "type": "string", "default": "{{customer_id}}" },
            "order_number": { "type": "string", "description": "Order number, digits only", "default": "{{order_number}}" }
          },
          "required": ["order_number"]
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "response_mapping": [
    { "path": "data.status", "variable": "order_status" }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `type` | Always `"function"` |
| `function.name` | Tool name. The model calls it by this name. Result variables are named after it |
| `function.handler` | Which runtime executes the tool. See the table below |
| `function.description` | Read by the dialogue model when the tool is in `tools`. Ignored in `pre_actions` |
| `function.parameters` | JSON-schema object. `properties` holds the parameters |
| `config.timeoutMs` | Timeout of one attempt, in milliseconds |
| `config.maxRetries` | Tool-level retries of a failed call |
| `config.interruptible` | `false` makes the tool run in the background. See "Background tools" |
| `config.alwaysRunsAt` | Makes the tool a lifecycle tool. See "Lifecycle tools" |
| `response_mapping` | Tool level, for tools in `tools`. Maps the result to variables |
| `pre_process_code` | Python hook that runs before the call |
| `post_process_code` | Python hook that runs after the call |

| Handler | Runs |
|---|---|
| `__function__:api_call` | An HTTP request |
| `__function__:code_exec` | A Python snippet in a sandbox |
| `__function__:end_call` | Hangs up. Used in the `terminal` of an `end_call` node |

Handlers for integrations, knowledge search, call transfer and rescheduling also exist. They are not needed here.

`api_call` parameters:

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `url` | Request URL. `{{var}}` works |
| `method` | HTTP method |
| `headers` | Object. Each header is a property with a `default` |
| `body` | Object. Each body field is a property under `body.properties` |
| `connect_retries` | Transport retries. See "Retries and timeouts" |

367	## Pre and post Python hooks
368	
369	An `api_call` tool can carry two Python snippets. They run on the server, in a sandbox, right before and right after the call. They are top-level fields of the tool object.
370	
371	```json
372	{
373	  "type": "function",
374	  "config": { "timeoutMs": 10000, "maxRetries": 0 },
375	  "function": {
376	    "name": "check_answer",
377	    "handler": "__function__:api_call",
378	    "description": "Check one answer. CALL it every time the caller answers the question.",
379	    "parameters": {
380	      "type": "object",
381	      "properties": {
382	        "url": { "type": "string", "default": "https://api.example.com/v1/check_answer" },
383	        "method": { "type": "string", "default": "POST" },
384	        "body": { "type": "object", "properties": { "answer": { "type": "string", "description": "The caller's answer", "default": "{{answer}}" } }, "required": ["answer"] }
385	      }
386	    }
387	  },
388	  "pre_process_code": "vars['member_code'] = str(vars.get('member_code') or '').strip().upper()",
389	  "post_process_code": "try:\n    if isinstance(result, dict):\n        result.pop('header', None)\n        d = result.get('data')\n        if isinstance(d, dict):\n            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Ask the next question.' if d.get('verified') else 'Ask the same question again.'\nexcept Exception:\n    pass\n"
390	}
391	```
392	
393	| Hook | Names available | Use |
394	|---|---|---|
395	| `pre_process_code` | `vars`: mutable dict that fills the `{{var}}` placeholders of the request. `config`: the substituted request with `url`, `method`, `headers`, `body` | Clean a value, or rewrite the whole request |
396	| `post_process_code` | `result`: the tool result, mutable | Reshape, shorten or extend the result |
397	
398	Documented behaviour:
399	
400	- The post-hook runs before `response_mapping` and extraction see the result.
401	- An empty or whitespace-only string means no hook.
402	- Hooks are honoured only on `api_call` tools (and on the integration and knowledge search handlers). The platform removes them from any other handler when the workflow is saved.
403	- In a pre-hook, setting `config['body']` to a string sends that string as the raw body, with no JSON encoding. Set the `Content-Type` header yourself in that case.
404	
405	### What `result` looks like in a post-hook
406	
407	The internal reference shows `result` as the response body. A working builder shows otherwise. Verified in a working builder:
408	
409	- For an `api_call`, `result` is the envelope described above: a dict with `status`, `data`, `message`, `status_code` and `header`. The API's JSON body is `result["data"]`.
410	- A key that the hook adds inside `result["data"]` reaches the dialogue model as part of the tool result. The working builder adds a `what_to_do_next` sentence there, and its prompt tells the model to obey it.
411	- `result.pop("header", None)` removes the response headers. The working builder does this on every tool, so that headers do not take up space in the model's context.
412	- Mapping paths still start with `data.` when a post-hook is present.
413	
414	The working builder writes every hook inside `try` and `except Exception: pass` and checks types with `isinstance` before use. What the platform does when a hook raises is not documented.
415	
416	Seen in a test on 10 October: a post-hook can read call variables and write new variables, and a later pre-hook reads them. Not confirmed: whether a change to `result` also changes the flattened `<tool>_response.*` variables.

## Pre and post Python hooks

An `api_call` tool can carry two Python snippets. They run on the server, in a sandbox, right before and right after the call. They are top-level fields of the tool object.

```json
{
  "type": "function",
  "config": { "timeoutMs": 10000, "maxRetries": 0 },
  "function": {
    "name": "check_answer",
    "handler": "__function__:api_call",
    "description": "Check one answer. CALL it every time the caller answers the question.",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "url": { "type": "string", "default": "https://api.example.com/v1/check_answer" },
        "method": { "type": "string", "default": "POST" },
        "body": { "type": "object", "properties": { "answer": { "type": "string", "description": "The caller's answer", "default": "{{answer}}" } }, "required": ["answer"] }
      }
    }
  },
  "pre_process_code": "vars['member_code'] = str(vars.get('member_code') or '').strip().upper()",
  "post_process_code": "try:\n    if isinstance(result, dict):\n        result.pop('header', None)\n        d = result.get('data')\n        if isinstance(d, dict):\n            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Ask the next question.' if d.get('verified') else 'Ask the same question again.'\nexcept Exception:\n    pass\n"
}
```

| Hook | Names available | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `pre_process_code` | `vars`: mutable dict that fills the `{{var}}` placeholders of the request. `config`: the substituted request with `url`, `method`, `headers`, `body` | Clean a value, or rewrite the whole request |
| `post_process_code` | `result`: the tool result, mutable | Reshape, shorten or extend the result |

Documented behaviour:

- The post-hook runs before `response_mapping` and extraction see the result.
- An empty or whitespace-only string means no hook.
- Hooks are honoured only on `api_call` tools (and on the integration and knowledge search handlers). The platform removes them from any other handler when the workflow is saved.
- In a pre-hook, setting `config['body']` to a string sends that string as the raw body, with no JSON encoding. Set the `Content-Type` header yourself in that case.

### What `result` looks like in a post-hook

The internal reference shows `result` as the response body. A working builder shows otherwise. Verified in a working builder:

- For an `api_call`, `result` is the envelope described above: a dict with `status`, `data`, `message`, `status_code` and `header`. The API's JSON body is `result["data"]`.
- A key that the hook adds inside `result["data"]` reaches the dialogue model as part of the tool result. The working builder adds a `what_to_do_next` sentence there, and its prompt tells the model to obey it.
- `result.pop("header", None)` removes the response headers. The working builder does this on every tool, so that headers do not take up space in the model's context.
- Mapping paths still start with `data.` when a post-hook is present.

The working builder writes every hook inside `try` and `except Exception: pass` and checks types with `isinstance` before use. What the platform does when a hook raises is not documented.

Seen in a test on 10 October: a post-hook can read call variables and write new variables, and a later pre-hook reads them. Not confirmed: whether a change to `result` also changes the flattened `<tool>_response.*` variables.

import json, subprocess, sys, os

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SKILL = os.path.join(ROOT, ".claude", "skills", "build-phone-agent")
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "out")
BASE = "https://freya-bank-mock.freyavoice.workers.dev/v1"


def code_of(snippet, out):
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(SKILL, "scripts", "build_code.py"), os.path.join(OUT, snippet), "--out", os.path.join(OUT, out)], check=True)
    return open(os.path.join(OUT, out), encoding="utf-8").read()


SETUP_CODE = code_of("brief-b_setup_snippet.py", "brief-b_setup_code.txt")
ACCOUNT_CODE = code_of("brief-b_account_snippet.py", "brief-b_account_code.txt")


def code_node(name, code, nxt):
    return {"name": name, "node_type": "code", "passthrough": True, "passthrough_default_transition": nxt,
            "on_enter": {"type": "silent"}, "disable_inactivity_monitor": True,
            "pre_actions": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "code_exec", "handler": "__function__:code_exec",
                             "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                                 "code": {"type": "string", "default": code},
                                 "timeout_ms": {"type": "number", "default": 10000}}}}}],
            "transitions": [{"target_node": nxt, "description": "always", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}]}


def api_tool(name, desc, body_props, required, retries=0, post=None, pre=None, mapping=None):
    props = {"customer_id": {"type": "string", "default": "{{customer_id}}", "description": "The customer id. Filled automatically."}}
    props.update(body_props)
    t = {"type": "function", "config": {"timeoutMs": 12000, "maxRetries": retries},
         "function": {"name": name, "handler": "__function__:api_call", "description": desc,
                      "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                          "url": {"type": "string", "default": BASE + "/" + name},
                          "method": {"type": "string", "default": "POST"},
                          "headers": {"type": "object", "properties": {"Content-Type": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"}}},
                          "body": {"type": "object", "properties": props, "required": required}}}}}
    if post:
        t["post_process_code"] = post
    if pre:
        t["pre_process_code"] = pre
    if mapping:
        t["response_mapping"] = mapping
    return t


def hook(body):
    """body: lines using d (data dict) and ok (bool). Indented by 8 spaces."""
    return ("try:\n"
            "    if isinstance(result, dict):\n"
            "        result.pop('header', None)\n"
            "        d = result.get('data')\n"
            "        if not isinstance(d, dict):\n"
            "            d = dict()\n"
            "            result['data'] = d\n"
            "        ok = d.get('ok') is True and int(result.get('status_code') or 200) < 400\n"
            + body +
            "except Exception:\n"
            "    pass\n")


# ---------- hooks ----------
VERIFY_POST = hook(
    "        left = d.get('wrong_answers_left')\n"
    "        if d.get('hint') == 'day_month_swapped':\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Day and month seem swapped. This does not count as a wrong answer. Ask the customer to say their date of birth again with the month as a word (for example: the third of June). Then call verify_identity again.'\n"
    "        elif d.get('all_verified') is True:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Both security questions passed. Say only: Thank you.'\n"
    "        elif d.get('verified') is True:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Date of birth is correct. Now ask: Could you please tell me the last four digits of the phone number we have on file? Then call verify_identity with field phone_last4.'\n"
    "        elif not ok and left is None:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The answer could not be read (not counted as wrong). Ask the same question again, clearly, and call verify_identity again. Send a date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD.'\n"
    "        elif left is not None and int(left) <= 0:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Three wrong answers: the check has ended. Do NOT say why you are calling. Say: I am sorry, I cannot continue without verifying your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch. Thank you, goodbye. In the same turn call close_call with outcome not_verified and reason failed.'\n"
    "        else:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'That answer did not match. Wrong answers left: ' + str(left) + '. Ask the SAME question once more, then call verify_identity again with the same field.'\n")

PROMISE_POST = hook(
    "        if ok:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'RECORDED. If more agreed promises remain, call create_promise for the next one now (one tool call per message). When all agreed promises are recorded, say that the promises are recorded and say exactly: You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Then handle any product without a promise (add_note), then thank the customer, say goodbye and call close_call.'\n"
    "        else:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'NOT recorded. Never say it is recorded. If this was the FIRST try for this product, call create_promise again now with exactly the same values. If it was the SECOND try, tell the customer you could not record the promise for this product, then call add_note for this product with reason service_error, and continue with the other products.'\n")

NOTE_POST = hook(
    "        if ok:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Note saved. Continue: next product, next note, or, when every product is done, thank the customer, say goodbye and call close_call with the right outcome.'\n"
    "        else:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The note was not saved. Call add_note once more with the same values.'\n")

TRANSFER_POST = hook(
    "        if ok:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Transfer accepted. Do NOT call add_note. Say: I am transferring you now, thank you and goodbye. In the same turn call close_call with outcome transferred and the reason that matches the queue (restructuring -> restructuring, support -> support, general -> human).'\n"
    "        else:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The transfer failed. Tell the customer you could not transfer the call right now, call transfer_to_agent once more with the same queue.'\n")

CALLBACK_POST = hook(
    "        if ok:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Callback booked. Say that we will call back then, thank them, say goodbye and in the same turn call close_call with outcome not_reached and reason callback.'\n"
    "        else:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The callback was NOT booked. Do not say it is booked. Call schedule_callback once more with the same values; if it fails again, apologise, say goodbye and call close_call with outcome not_reached and reason no_callback.'\n")

CLOSE_PRE = ("try:\n"
             "    b = config.get('body')\n"
             "    if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get('outcome') in ('promise', 'paid'):\n"
             "        b.pop('reason', None)\n"
             "except Exception:\n"
             "    pass\n")
CLOSE_POST = hook("        d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The call is closed. Say nothing more.'\n")

REASON_DESC = {
    "callback": "not_reached: a callback was booked (rule 6)",
    "no_callback": "not_reached: two offered times were outside the window, nothing booked",
    "wrong_number": "not_reached: the number does not belong to the customer",
    "deceased": "not_reached: the customer has died",
    "unclear": "not_reached: still unclear who is on the line after the second ask",
    "failed": "not_verified: three wrong security answers",
    "declined": "not_verified: declined the security questions twice, or does not want to talk before verification",
    "human": "transferred: insisted on a human (queue general)",
    "support": "transferred: hardship, accepted the support team (queue support)",
    "restructuring": "transferred: asked for a new plan or lower instalments (queue restructuring)",
    "refused": "no_promise: refused / attempts used up / does not want to talk",
    "hardship": "no_promise: hardship, declined the support team",
    "dispute": "no_promise: says the debt or product is not theirs",
    "service_error": "no_promise: create_promise failed twice",
}


def close_tool(outcomes, reasons, extra=""):
    desc_r = "; ".join(r + " = " + REASON_DESC[r] for r in reasons)
    return api_tool("close_call",
                    "End the call. Call it exactly once, LAST, in the same turn as your thank-you and goodbye. Nothing can be called after it. " + extra,
                    {"outcome": {"type": "string", "enum": outcomes, "default": "{{close_outcome}}", "description": "Outcome of the call. " + extra},
                     "reason": {"type": "string", "enum": reasons, "default": "{{close_reason}}", "description": "Reason. Leave empty for promise and paid. " + desc_r}},
                    ["outcome"], retries=1, pre=CLOSE_PRE, post=CLOSE_POST)


def transfer_tool(queues, desc):
    return api_tool("transfer_to_agent", desc,
                    {"queue": {"type": "string", "enum": queues, "default": "{{transfer_queue}}", "description": "restructuring = new plan or lower instalments; support = hardship accepted support; general = customer insisted on a human."}},
                    ["queue"], retries=0, post=TRANSFER_POST)


END_T = {"target_node": "end", "description": "the call was closed", "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [
    {"variable": "close_call_response.data.ok", "operator": "equals", "operand": "true"},
    {"variable": "close_call_response.data.ok", "operator": "equals", "operand": "True"}]}}

FORBID = ("Before identity is verified NEVER say why you are calling. Never say these words: collections, debt, payment, owe, overdue, late, amount, credit card, loan, account balance. "
          "If asked what the call is about, say only that it is a personal matter for {{title}} {{last_name}}.")

SYSTEM = ("You are Freya Bank's digital assistant on a recorded phone call. Speak English, short sentences, one question per turn. "
          "Address the customer as {{title}} {{last_name}}. "
          "After every tool result, read what_to_do_next and do it in the same turn. Never end a turn with nothing said. One tool call per message. "
          "If asked whether you are a robot or an AI: say you are Freya Bank's digital assistant, then continue. "

import json, subprocess, sys, os

SKILL = ".claude/skills/build-phone-agent"
SERVER = "https://freya-bank-mock.freyavoice.workers.dev/v1"


def code_of(snippet, out):
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, SKILL + "/scripts/build_code.py", snippet, "--out", out], check=True)
    return open(out, encoding="utf-8").read()


def api_tool(name, desc, body_props, required, post=None, pre=None, retries=0, mapping=None):
    props = {"customer_id": {"type": "string", "default": "{{customer_id}}"}}
    props.update(body_props)
    t = {"type": "function", "config": {"timeoutMs": 12000, "maxRetries": retries},
         "function": {"name": name, "handler": "__function__:api_call", "description": desc,
                      "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                          "url": {"type": "string", "default": SERVER + "/" + name},
                          "method": {"type": "string", "default": "POST"},
                          "headers": {"type": "object", "properties": {"Content-Type": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"}}},
                          "body": {"type": "object", "properties": props, "required": required}}}}}
    if post:
        t["post_process_code"] = post
    if pre:
        t["pre_process_code"] = pre
    if mapping:
        t["response_mapping"] = mapping
    return t


def hook(ok_line, fail_line, extra=""):
    return ("try:\n"
            "    if isinstance(result, dict):\n"
            "        result.pop('header', None)\n"
            "        d = result.get('data')\n"

            "        if ok:\n"

            "        else:\n"
            "            d['what_to_do_next'] = " + repr(fail_line) + "\n"
            "except Exception:\n"

          "If asked whether this is a scam: say they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number, then continue.\n"

          "Before close_call always thank the customer and say goodbye in the same turn. close_call is always the last tool call.")

                "transitions": [{"target_node": nxt, "description": "always", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}]}

                  "then close with outcome transferred, reason human.")

    greet = {
        "name": "greet", "node_type": "conversation",
        "on_enter": {"type": "tts", "text": GREET_LINE}, "on_enter_first_entry_only": True,
        "task_message": ("You have said the opening and asked whether you are speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}} ({{first_name}} {{last_name}}). " + FORBID + "\n"
                         "Only 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking' or the customer's own name confirms. 'Hello', 'go ahead', 'who is this' do NOT confirm.\n"

If still unclear after this second ask, thank them, say goodbye and call close_call with outcome not_reached, reason unclear.\n"
                         "- The number does not belong to the customer: thank, goodbye, close_call not_reached, wrong_number.\n"
                         "- The customer has died: say exactly \"I am sorry for your loss.\", ask nothing else, say goodbye, close_call not_reached, deceased.\n"

                             "unclear, wrong_number, deceased go with not_reached; declined with not_verified; human with transferred."),

                        {"target_node": "third_party", "description": "someone else answered", "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"variable": "line_status", "operator": "equals", "operand": "someone_else"}]}}],

        "name": "third_party", "node_type": "conversation", "on_enter": {"type": "llm"},
        "task_message": ("You are talking to someone who is not {{title}} {{last_name}}. " + FORBID + " Say nothing beyond that you are Freya Bank's digital assistant. "
                         "Tell them nothing about any account even if they offer to pay, and never ask them security questions.\n"
                         "Ask when {{title}} {{last_name}} can be reached.\n"
                         "Callback window facts:\n{{date_facts}}\n"
                         "- They give a day and time inside the window: call schedule_callback with date YYYY-MM-DD and time HH:MM. If ok, say the callback is booked, thank, goodbye, close_call not_reached, callback.\n"
                         "- Outside the window (other day, before 10:00, after 19:00, or not later than now): ask once for another time within the window. If the second answer is also outside, do not schedule: thank, goodbye, close_call not_reached, no_callback. Same if they give no time.\n"
                         "- The number is not the customer's: close_call not_reached, wrong_number.\n"
                         "- The customer has died: say exactly \"I am sorry for your loss.\", ask nothing else, say goodbye, close_call not_reached, deceased.\n"

        "extraction_schema": [{"name": "late_confirm", "type": "string", "min_confidence": 0.8, "enum_values": ["confirmed", "no"],

        "transitions": [END_TRANS,
                        {"target_node": "identity", "description": "the customer is on the line after all", "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"variable": "late_confirm", "operator": "equals", "operand": "confirmed"}]}}],
    }

    identity = {
        "name": "identity", "node_type": "conversation",
        "on_enter": {"type": "tts", "text": "Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions. What is your date of birth?"},
        "on_enter_first_entry_only": True,
        "task_message": ("You are checking the identity of {{title}} {{last_name}}. " + FORBID + "\n"

        "tools": [api_tool("verify_identity", "Check one security answer. CALL it after every answer the customer gives.",

                                               "method": {"type": "string", "default": "POST"},
                                               "headers": {"type": "object", "properties": {"Content-Type": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"}}},

             "transitions": [{"target_node": "account", "description": "always", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}]}

    collect_task = (
        "Identity is verified. You have just stated every late product and asked whether the customer can pay all of them today.\n"
        "PRODUCTS (in this order):\n{{account_facts}}\n\n"

        "HOW TO NEGOTIATE\n"
        "- If they can pay everything today: each product gets its full amount today.\n"

          "test_variables": {"customer_id": "c_test", "first_name": "Dana", "last_name": "Fisher", "title": "Ms", "now": "2026-10-14T11:00"},

### Entry behaviour

| `on_enter` | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `{"type": "llm"}` | The model writes the first line from `task_message`. Default. An optional `prompt` key overrides the entry instruction for this node |
| `{"type": "tts", "text": "..."}` | A fixed line is spoken. No model call. `{{var}}` works in `text` |
| `{"type": "silent"}` | Nothing is said. The node waits for the user, or routes at once if it is a passthrough node |
| `{"type": "audio", "asset_id": "..."}` | Plays a recorded asset. Not needed here |

Set `on_enter_first_entry_only` to `true` when a node can be re-entered and must not repeat its opening line. This works better than a prompt rule such as "do not greet twice".

### History across nodes

When the conversation moves from node A to node B:

- User and assistant messages are kept.
- The system message is replaced by node B's prompts.
- A loop prompt from node A is removed.

So node B can refer to anything said earlier. Variables also stay for the whole call.

## Variables

449:Set `is_tool_call` to `true` on a transition. The dialogue model then sees the transition as a tool named `transition_to_<node>` and triggers it by calling that tool. The router does not evaluate it after each turn.
530:`extraction_schema` is an array on a node. After each user message the extraction model fills the listed variables from the conversation.
567:1. The extraction model sees recent messages and the schema.
576:- **`extraction_prompt` replaces the whole built-in template.** It is not appended. A custom prompt must contain the input placeholders itself: `{{extractor.speech}}`, `{{extractor.conversation.last-10}}`, `{{extractor.type_preamble}}` and `{{extractor.variables_list}}`. Without them the extractor never sees the user's message and returns nothing on every turn, while dialogue and routing look healthy.

OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "out")

def code_of(snippet, out):
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(SKILL, "scripts", "build_code.py"), os.path.join(OUT, snippet), "--out", os.path.join(OUT, out)], check=True)

def api_tool(name, desc, body_props, required, retries=0, post=None, pre=None, mapping=None):
    props = {"customer_id": {"type": "string", "default": "{{customer_id}}", "description": "The customer id. Filled automatically."}}
    props.update(body_props)
    t = {"type": "function", "config": {"timeoutMs": 12000, "maxRetries": retries},
         "function": {"name": name, "handler": "__function__:api_call", "description": desc,
                      "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                          "url": {"type": "string", "default": BASE + "/" + name},
                          "method": {"type": "string", "default": "POST"},
                          "headers": {"type": "object", "properties": {"Content-Type": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"}}},
                          "body": {"type": "object", "properties": props, "required": required}}}}}
    if post:
        t["post_process_code"] = post
    if pre:
        t["pre_process_code"] = pre
    if mapping:
        t["response_mapping"] = mapping
    return t

Do you confirm?" If a product moved to its deadline, say: "<product> can be recorded at the latest on its deadline, <date>." Products that ended without a promise are not read back.
+- If the customer changes a date or amount: check it again (DATE ANSWERS, floor) and read everything back again.
+- You cannot record anything in this step and you must NEVER say recorded, booked, saved, registered, set up or done. After the customer's yes the next step records.

+- Persuasion is per product: a refusal of a product that still has an attempt left is NEVER the end of that product. In your next reply make its next attempt exactly as written in ACCOUNT FACTS (one product at a time). Only when its attempts are used up is the product ended (refused).

+- When EVERY product has ended without any agreed promise (attempts used, dispute, already paid, hardship declined, or the customer said twice they do not want to talk), say: "Thank you, I will note this on your account." (nothing else).
+- Transfers (restructuring, support, human): call transfer_to_agent, then thank, goodbye and close_call transferred with its reason. No notes."""

+collect["tools"] = [transfer_tool(["restructuring", "support", "general"], "Transfer the call to a person. restructuring: new plan or lower instalments. support: hardship and the customer accepted. general: customer insisted on a human after you asked once whether you can help."),
+                    close_tool(["transferred"], ["restructuring", "human", "support"], "Only after a transfer in this step.")]

+                                 "description": "confirmed ONLY if the assistant's previous message was the read-back of the promises ending with 'Do you confirm?' and the customer now clearly said yes. all_ended ONLY if the assistant's previous message said 'I will note this on your account' (every product ended without a promise). continue in every other case, including when the customer agrees to a single offer that has not been read back yet."}]
+The negotiation is finished. Everything agreed is in the conversation above. Do these steps in order, one tool call per message, following what_to_do_next after each result:

+1. For each promise the customer confirmed in the read-back: call create_promise (product_id from ACCOUNT FACTS, amount as a number, date YYYY-MM-DD exactly as read back). If one fails, try it once more; if it fails again, tell the customer you could not record it and call add_note with reason service_error for that product. Say a promise is recorded only after create_promise returned ok.
+2. After the recorded promises say exactly: "You will receive a text message confirming this promise."

+3. For each product WITHOUT a recorded promise: call add_note with its product_id and the reason from the conversation: refused (refused after the attempts, or does not want to talk), hardship (hardship, declined support), dispute (not theirs / closed or paid off in the past), paid (already paid this amount), service_error (create_promise failed twice).
+4. Thank the customer, say goodbye and, in the same turn, call close_call:
+   - at least one promise recorded: outcome promise;
+   - no promise and every product noted paid: outcome paid;
+   - otherwise outcome no_promise with the reason of the FIRST product (ACCOUNT FACTS order) whose note is not paid.

+A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled now: say they can change it in the mobile app. If the customer now asks for a new plan or lower instalments: call transfer_to_agent queue restructuring, add no notes, close transferred / restructuring."""

+    "on_enter": {"type": "llm", "prompt": "Start step 1 now: call the first tool (create_promise for the first confirmed promise, or add_note if no promise was agreed). Do not speak before the tool call."},

import json, subprocess, sys, os

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SKILL = os.path.join(ROOT, ".claude", "skills", "build-phone-agent")
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "out")
BASE = "https://freya-bank-mock.freyavoice.workers.dev/v1"


def code_of(snippet, out):
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(SKILL, "scripts", "build_code.py"), os.path.join(OUT, snippet), "--out", os.path.join(OUT, out)], check=True)
    return open(os.path.join(OUT, out), encoding="utf-8").read()


SETUP_CODE = code_of("brief-b_setup_snippet.py", "brief-b_setup_code.txt")
ACCOUNT_CODE = code_of("brief-b_account_snippet.py", "brief-b_account_code.txt")


def code_node(name, code, nxt):
    return {"name": name, "node_type": "code", "passthrough": True, "passthrough_default_transition": nxt,
            "on_enter": {"type": "silent"}, "disable_inactivity_monitor": True,
            "pre_actions": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "code_exec", "handler": "__function__:code_exec",
                             "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                                 "code": {"type": "string", "default": code},
                                 "timeout_ms": {"type": "number", "default": 10000}}}}}],
            "transitions": [{"target_node": nxt, "description": "always", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}]}


def api_tool(name, desc, body_props, required, retries=0, post=None, pre=None, mapping=None):
    props = {"customer_id": {"type": "string", "default": "{{customer_id}}", "description": "The customer id. Filled automatically."}}
    props.update(body_props)
    t = {"type": "function", "config": {"timeoutMs": 12000, "maxRetries": retries},
         "function": {"name": name, "handler": "__function__:api_call", "description": desc,
                      "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                          "url": {"type": "string", "default": BASE + "/" + name},
                          "method": {"type": "string", "default": "POST"},
                          "headers": {"type": "object", "properties": {"Content-Type": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"}}},
                          "body": {"type": "object", "properties": props, "required": required}}}}}
    if post:
        t["post_process_code"] = post
    if pre:
        t["pre_process_code"] = pre
    if mapping:
        t["response_mapping"] = mapping
    return t


def hook(body):
    """body: lines using d (data dict) and ok (bool). Indented by 8 spaces."""
    return ("try:\n"
            "    if isinstance(result, dict):\n"
            "        result.pop('header', None)\n"
            "        d = result.get('data')\n"
            "        if not isinstance(d, dict):\n"
            "            d = dict()\n"
            "            result['data'] = d\n"
            "        ok = d.get('ok') is True and int(result.get('status_code') or 200) < 400\n"
            + body +
            "except Exception:\n"
            "    pass\n")


# ---------- hooks ----------
VERIFY_POST = hook(
    "        left = d.get('wrong_answers_left')\n"
    "        if d.get('hint') == 'day_month_swapped':\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Day and month seem swapped. This does not count as a wrong answer. Ask the customer to say their date of birth again with the month as a word (for example: the third of June). Then call verify_identity again.'\n"
    "        elif d.get('all_verified') is True:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Both security questions passed. Say only: Thank you.'\n"
    "        elif d.get('verified') is True:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Date of birth is correct. Now ask: Could you please tell me the last four digits of the phone number we have on file? Then call verify_identity with field phone_last4.'\n"
    "        elif not ok and left is None:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The answer could not be read (not counted as wrong). Ask the same question again, clearly, and call verify_identity again. Send a date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD.'\n"
    "        elif left is not None and int(left) <= 0:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Three wrong answers: the check has ended. Do NOT say why you are calling. Say: I am sorry, I cannot continue without verifying your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch. Thank you, goodbye. In the same turn call close_call with outcome not_verified and reason failed.'\n"
    "        else:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'That answer did not match. Wrong answers left: ' + str(left) + '. Ask the SAME question once more, then call verify_identity again with the same field.'\n")

PROMISE_POST = hook(
    "        if ok:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'RECORDED. If more agreed promises remain, call create_promise for the next one now (one tool call per message). When all agreed promises are recorded, say that the promises are recorded and say exactly: You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Then handle any product without a promise (add_note), then thank the customer, say goodbye and call close_call.'\n"
    "        else:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'NOT recorded. Never say it is recorded. If this was the FIRST try for this product, call create_promise again now with exactly the same values. If it was the SECOND try, tell the customer you could not record the promise for this product, then call add_note for this product with reason service_error, and continue with the other products.'\n")

NOTE_POST = hook(
    "        if ok:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Note saved. Continue: next product, next note, or, when every product is done, thank the customer, say goodbye and call close_call with the right outcome.'\n"
    "        else:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The note was not saved. Call add_note once more with the same values.'\n")

TRANSFER_POST = hook(
    "        if ok:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Transfer accepted. Do NOT call add_note. Say: I am transferring you now, thank you and goodbye. In the same turn call close_call with outcome transferred and the reason that matches the queue (restructuring -> restructuring, support -> support, general -> human).'\n"
    "        else:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The transfer failed. Tell the customer you could not transfer the call right now, call transfer_to_agent once more with the same queue.'\n")

CALLBACK_POST = hook(
    "        if ok:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Callback booked. Say that we will call back then, thank them, say goodbye and in the same turn call close_call with outcome not_reached and reason callback.'\n"
    "        else:\n"
    "            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The callback was NOT booked. Do not say it is booked. Call schedule_callback once more with the same values; if it fails again, apologise, say goodbye and call close_call with outcome not_reached and reason no_callback.'\n")

CLOSE_PRE = ("try:\n"
             "    b = config.get('body')\n"
             "    if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get('outcome') in ('promise', 'paid'):\n"
             "        b.pop('reason', None)\n"
             "except Exception:\n"
             "    pass\n")
CLOSE_POST = hook("        d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The call is closed. Say nothing more.'\n")

REASON_DESC = {
    "callback": "not_reached: a callback was booked (rule 6)",
    "no_callback": "not_reached: two offered times were outside the window, nothing booked",
    "wrong_number": "not_reached: the number does not belong to the customer",
    "deceased": "not_reached: the customer has died",
    "unclear": "not_reached: still unclear who is on the line after the second ask",
    "failed": "not_verified: three wrong security answers",
    "declined": "not_verified: declined the security questions twice, or does not want to talk before verification",
    "human": "transferred: insisted on a human (queue general)",
    "support": "transferred: hardship, accepted the support team (queue support)",
    "restructuring": "transferred: asked for a new plan or lower instalments (queue restructuring)",
    "refused": "no_promise: refused / attempts used up / does not want to talk",
    "hardship": "no_promise: hardship, declined the support team",
    "dispute": "no_promise: says the debt or product is not theirs",
    "service_error": "no_promise: create_promise failed twice",
}


def close_tool(outcomes, reasons, extra=""):
    desc_r = "; ".join(r + " = " + REASON_DESC[r] for r in reasons)
    return api_tool("close_call",
                    "End the call. Call it exactly once, LAST, in the same turn as your thank-you and goodbye. Nothing can be called after it. " + extra,
                    {"outcome": {"type": "string", "enum": outcomes, "default": "{{close_outcome}}", "description": "Outcome of the call. " + extra},
                     "reason": {"type": "string", "enum": reasons, "default": "{{close_reason}}", "description": "Reason. Leave empty for promise and paid. " + desc_r}},
                    ["outcome"], retries=0, pre=CLOSE_PRE, post=CLOSE_POST)


def transfer_tool(queues, desc):
    return api_tool("transfer_to_agent", desc,
                    {"queue": {"type": "string", "enum": queues, "default": "{{transfer_queue}}", "description": "restructuring = new plan or lower instalments; support = hardship accepted support; general = customer insisted on a human."}},
                    ["queue"], retries=0, post=TRANSFER_POST)


END_T = {"target_node": "end", "description": "the call was closed", "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [
    {"variable": "close_call_response.data.ok", "operator": "equals", "operand": "true"},
    {"variable": "close_call_response.data.ok", "operator": "equals", "operand": "True"}]}}

FORBID = ("Before identity is verified NEVER say why you are calling. Never say these words: collections, debt, payment, owe, overdue, late, amount, credit card, loan, account balance. "
          "If asked what the call is about, say only that it is a personal matter for {{title}} {{last_name}}.")

SYSTEM = ("You are Freya Bank's digital assistant on a recorded phone call. Speak English, short sentences, one question per turn. "
          "Address the customer as {{title}} {{last_name}}. "
          "After every tool result, read what_to_do_next and do it in the same turn. Never end a turn with nothing said. One tool call per message. "
          "If asked whether you are a robot or an AI: say you are Freya Bank's digital assistant, then continue. "
          "If asked whether this is a scam: say they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number, then continue. "
          "If asked something the information you have cannot answer: say you do not have that information. Never invent figures, dates or reasons. "
          "If the person asks for a human: first ask once whether you can help them yourself. If they insist, call transfer_to_agent with queue general. "
          "Never claim an action that was not a successful tool call. Before close_call always thank the customer and say goodbye, in the same turn.\n"
          "Calendar facts:\n{{date_facts}}")

GREET_LINE = "Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"

greet = {
    "name": "greet", "node_type": "conversation",
    "on_enter": {"type": "tts", "text": GREET_LINE}, "on_enter_first_entry_only": True,
    "task_message": (
        "You asked: Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}? " + FORBID + "\n"
        "ONLY these count as confirmation: yes, that's me, speaking, or the customer saying their own name. 'Hello', 'go ahead', 'who is this' do NOT count.\n"
        "- Not a confirmation, or a question: answer the question if any (robot, scam), then ask again exactly: Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}? This is the second ask.\n"
        "- Still unclear after the second ask: say thank you and goodbye and call close_call with outcome not_reached, reason unclear.\n"
        "- The number does not belong to the customer: apologise, goodbye, close_call not_reached / wrong_number.\n"
        "- The customer has died: say exactly: I am sorry for your loss. Ask nothing else, say goodbye, close_call not_reached / deceased.\n"
        "- Says twice they do not want to talk: goodbye, close_call not_verified / declined.\n"
        "- Someone else answers (relative, colleague): do not explain anything (the next step handles it)."),
    "extraction_schema": [{"name": "line_status", "type": "string", "min_confidence": 0.6,
                           "enum_values": ["customer", "someone_else", "wrong_number", "deceased", "unclear"],
                           "description": "Who answered. customer ONLY if they said yes, that's me, speaking, or their own name ({{first_name}} {{last_name}}). someone_else if another person answered (relative, colleague) and the customer is not there or is someone else. wrong_number if the number is not the customer's. deceased if the customer died. unclear for hello, go ahead, who is this, or anything else."}],
    "tools": [close_tool(["not_reached", "not_verified", "transferred"], ["unclear", "wrong_number", "deceased", "declined", "human"]),
              transfer_tool(["general"], "Transfer to a human. CALL only when the person insisted on a human after you asked once whether you can help.")],
    "transitions": [END_T,
                    {"target_node": "identity", "description": "the customer confirmed", "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"variable": "line_status", "operator": "equals", "operand": "customer"}]}},
                    {"target_node": "third_party", "description": "someone else answered", "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"variable": "line_status", "operator": "equals", "operand": "someone_else"}]}}],
}

third_party = {
    "name": "third_party", "node_type": "conversation",
    "task_message": (
        "Someone other than {{title}} {{last_name}} is on the line. " + FORBID + " Do not ask security questions and tell them nothing about any account, even if they offer to pay.\n"
        "Ask when {{title}} {{last_name}} can be reached. The allowed callback times are in the calendar facts (today later than now, or the next business day, 10:00 to 19:00 both included).\n"
        "- A time inside the window: call schedule_callback with date YYYY-MM-DD and time HH:MM.\n"
        "- A day or time outside the window: ask ONCE for another time, saying when calls are possible. If the second answer is also outside: do not book, thank, goodbye, close_call not_reached / no_callback.\n"
        "- The number is not the customer's: close_call not_reached / wrong_number.\n"
        "- The customer has died: say exactly: I am sorry for your loss. Ask nothing else, goodbye, close_call not_reached / deceased.\n"
        "- It turns out the person IS {{title}} {{last_name}}: say thank you and ask: Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"),
    "extraction_schema": [{"name": "late_confirm", "type": "string", "min_confidence": 0.7, "enum_values": ["customer", "other"],
                           "description": "customer ONLY if the person now clearly says they are {{title}} {{last_name}} (yes, that's me, speaking). Otherwise other."}],
    "tools": [api_tool("schedule_callback", "Book a callback for the customer. CALL when the person gives a day and time inside the allowed window.",
                       {"date": {"type": "string", "default": "{{callback_date}}", "description": "Callback day, YYYY-MM-DD, today or the next business day (see calendar facts)."},
                        "time": {"type": "string", "default": "{{callback_time}}", "description": "HH:MM, 24 hour, from 10:00 to 19:00 both included, later than now when today."}},
                       ["date", "time"], retries=0, post=CALLBACK_POST),
              close_tool(["not_reached", "transferred"], ["callback", "no_callback", "wrong_number", "deceased", "human"]),
              transfer_tool(["general"], "Transfer to a human. CALL only when the person insisted on a human after you asked once whether you can help.")],
    "transitions": [END_T,
                    {"target_node": "identity", "description": "the customer is on the line", "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"variable": "late_confirm", "operator": "equals", "operand": "customer"}]}}],
}

identity = {
    "name": "identity", "node_type": "conversation",
    "on_enter": {"type": "tts", "text": "Thank you. Before we continue I need to ask two security questions. First, could you please tell me your date of birth?"},
    "on_enter_first_entry_only": True,
    "task_message": (
        "You are verifying identity. " + FORBID + "\n"
        "Questions, one at a time: 1) date of birth, 2) the last four digits of the phone number on file. After EACH answer call verify_identity (field date_of_birth or phone_last4).\n"
        "Send the date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD whatever way it was said. A date given only as numbers is day, then month, then year (03/06/1987 = 1987-06-03). Spoken words: 'the third of June nineteen eighty-seven' = 1987-06-03.\n"

COLLECT_TASK = """Identity is verified. You just said the debt statement and asked whether the customer can pay everything today.

ACCOUNT FACTS (in get_account order; use these exact ids, amounts and dates):
{{account_facts}}

DATE ANSWERS (when the customer names a day, find it here and do exactly what its line says for each product):
{{date_answers}}

HOW TO NEGOTIATE
1. The today question for all products is already asked. Never ask about today again per product. If the customer can pay everything today: each product = full past-due amount, today's date. Go to READ-BACK.
2. If not: go through the products ONE BY ONE in the order above. For each product start at its attempt 1. Say which product you are talking about.
3. Always ask for the FULL past-due amount first. NEVER ask "how much can you pay?". You propose every amount.
4. Decision table for the current product (first matching row wins):
   - Illness, a death in the family or job loss: one short sentence of sympathy, NO persuasion. Offer to connect them with the customer support team. Accepts: call transfer_to_agent queue support (no notes). Declines: this and every remaining product without a promise gets add_note reason hardship (unless the customer still names a date or amount themselves: then handle it normally).
   - New payment plan or lower instalments: do not describe any plan. Call transfer_to_agent queue restructuring. Agreed promises not yet recorded are NOT recorded. No notes at all.
   - "This is not mine", "I never had this product", or "it was closed / paid off in the past": do not argue, no promise for this product, add_note reason dispute, then continue with the next product.
   - "I already paid" this past-due amount: say payments can take one business day to appear, no promise for this product, add_note reason paid, then continue with the next product.
   - The customer names a date: look it up in DATE ANSWERS and do what it says for this product (accept, offer next business day, or say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it).
   - A vague period (next week, end of the month, when my salary comes): ask ONCE for the exact day. If still none: propose this product's deadline.
   - The full amount is too much: offer this product's floor ONCE and say that the rest stays overdue.
   - An amount from the floor up to the full amount: accept it. Below the floor: say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once; if not accepted, that is a flat refusal.
   - Refuses the deadline after a too-late date, refuses the floor, a flat no, or a non-answer: that uses ONE persuasion attempt for this product. Make the next attempt exactly as written in ACCOUNT FACTS. When this product has no attempts left: stop, do not repeat a refused offer, add_note reason refused for this product, then continue with the next product.
   - A date or an amount the customer proposes is never a refusal.
   If the customer refuses several products at once, still go through them one at a time and make each product's attempts.
5. ONE DATE FOR EVERYTHING: if the customer names one date for all products, check it per product in DATE ANSWERS. A product whose deadline is before that date is recorded on its own deadline; the others keep the named date. Say so in the read-back.
6. Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or anything not listed here.

READ-BACK (once, for ALL agreed promises together): "To confirm: <product name>, <amount>, on <date>; <next product>, <amount>, on <date>. Do you confirm?" If a product moved to its deadline, say: "<product> can be recorded at the latest on its deadline, <date>." Until create_promise returns ok NEVER say recorded, booked, saved, registered, set up or done.
- If the customer changes a date or amount: check it again (DATE ANSWERS, floor) and read everything back again.
- After a clear yes: call create_promise once per agreed product, one call per message, product_id from ACCOUNT FACTS, amount as a number, date YYYY-MM-DD. Follow what_to_do_next.
- A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in this call: say they can change it in the mobile app.
- After the promises are recorded say exactly: "You will receive a text message confirming this promise."

NOTES: every product without a recorded promise gets exactly one add_note with its product_id and reason (refused, hardship, dispute, paid, service_error). This also applies when no product gets a promise. EXCEPTION: on any transfer (restructuring, support, human) call no add_note at all, before or after it.
If the customer says twice they do not want to talk: every product without a promise gets add_note reason refused, then close.

CLOSING (thank, goodbye and close_call in the same turn, after all notes):
- After a transfer: outcome transferred, reason restructuring / support / human (also when promises were recorded before).
- At least one promise recorded: outcome promise.
- No promise recorded and every product noted paid: outcome paid.

def code_of(snippet, out):
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(SKILL, "scripts", "build_code.py"), os.path.join(OUT, snippet), "--out", os.path.join(OUT, out)], check=True)
    return open(os.path.join(OUT, out), encoding="utf-8").read()

def code_node(name, code, nxt):
    return {"name": name, "node_type": "code", "passthrough": True, "passthrough_default_transition": nxt,
            "on_enter": {"type": "silent"}, "disable_inactivity_monitor": True,
            "pre_actions": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "code_exec", "handler": "__function__:code_exec",
                             "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                                 "code": {"type": "string", "default": code},
                                 "timeout_ms": {"type": "number", "default": 10000}}}}}],
            "transitions": [{"target_node": nxt, "description": "always", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}]}


def api_tool(name, desc, body_props, required, retries=0, post=None, pre=None, mapping=None):
    props = {"customer_id": {"type": "string", "default": "{{customer_id}}", "description": "The customer id. Filled automatically."}}
    props.update(body_props)
    t = {"type": "function", "config": {"timeoutMs": 12000, "maxRetries": retries},
         "function": {"name": name, "handler": "__function__:api_call", "description": desc,
                      "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
                          "url": {"type": "string", "default": BASE + "/" + name},
                          "method": {"type": "string", "default": "POST"},
                          "headers": {"type": "object", "properties": {"Content-Type": {"type": "string", "default": "application/json"}}},
                          "body": {"type": "object", "properties": props, "required": required}}}}}
    if post:
        t["post_process_code"] = post
    if pre:
        t["pre_process_code"] = pre
    if mapping:
        t["response_mapping"] = mapping
    return t

- Persuasion is per product: a refusal of a product that still has an attempt left is NEVER the end of that product. In your next reply make its next attempt exactly as written in ACCOUNT FACTS (one product at a time). Only when its attempts are used up is the product ended (refused).
- When EVERY product has ended without any agreed promise (attempts used, dispute, already paid, hardship declined, or the customer said twice they do not want to talk), say: "Thank you, I will note this on your account." (nothing else).
- Transfers (restructuring, support, human): call transfer_to_agent, then thank, goodbye and close_call transferred with its reason. No notes."""

collect["task_message"] = NEGOTIATE_TASK.replace("gets add_note reason", "ends as").replace("add_note reason", "it ends as")
collect["tools"] = [transfer_tool(["restructuring", "support", "general"], "Transfer the call to a person. restructuring: new plan or lower instalments. support: hardship and the customer accepted. general: customer insisted on a human after you asked once whether you can help."),
                    close_tool(["transferred"], ["restructuring", "human", "support"], "Only after a transfer in this step.")]
collect["extraction_schema"] = [{"name": "deal_state", "type": "string", "min_confidence": 0.8,
                                 "enum_values": ["confirmed", "all_ended", "continue"],
                                 "description": "confirmed ONLY if the assistant's previous message was the read-back of the promises ending with 'Do you confirm?' and the customer now clearly said yes. all_ended ONLY if the assistant's previous message said 'I will note this on your account' (every product ended without a promise). continue in every other case, including when the customer agrees to a single offer that has not been read back yet."}]
collect["transitions"] = [END_T,
                          {"target_node": "record", "description": "read-back confirmed or every product ended", "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [
                              {"variable": "deal_state", "operator": "equals", "operand": "confirmed"},
                              {"variable": "deal_state", "operator": "equals", "operand": "all_ended"}]}}]

RECORD_TASK = """ACCOUNT FACTS (in get_account order):
{{account_facts}}

The negotiation is finished. Everything agreed is in the conversation above. Do these steps in order, one tool call per message, following what_to_do_next after each result:
1. For each promise the customer confirmed in the read-back: call create_promise (product_id from ACCOUNT FACTS, amount as a number, date YYYY-MM-DD exactly as read back). If one fails, try it once more; if it fails again, tell the customer you could not record it and call add_note with reason service_error for that product. Say a promise is recorded only after create_promise returned ok.
2. After the recorded promises say exactly: "You will receive a text message confirming this promise."
3. For each product WITHOUT a recorded promise: call add_note with its product_id and the reason from the conversation: refused (refused after the attempts, or does not want to talk), hardship (hardship, declined support), dispute (not theirs / closed or paid off in the past), paid (already paid this amount), service_error (create_promise failed twice).
4. Thank the customer, say goodbye and, in the same turn, call close_call:
   - at least one promise recorded: outcome promise;
   - no promise and every product noted paid: outcome paid;
   - otherwise outcome no_promise with the reason of the FIRST product (ACCOUNT FACTS order) whose note is not paid.
A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled now: say they can change it in the mobile app. If the customer now asks for a new plan or lower instalments: call transfer_to_agent queue restructuring, add no notes, close transferred / restructuring."""

record = {
    "name": "record", "node_type": "conversation",
    "on_enter": {"type": "tts", "text": "Thank you. One moment please."}, "on_enter_first_entry_only": True,
    "task_message": RECORD_TASK,
    "tools": _rec_tools,
    "transitions": [END_T],
}

end = {"name": "end", "node_type": "end_call", "on_enter": {"type": "silent"}, "disable_inactivity_monitor": True, "transitions": [],
       "terminal": {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "call_closed", "handler": "__function__:end_call",
                                                      "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"message_mode": {"type": "string", "default": "none"}}}}}}

wf = {
    "initial_node": "setup",
    "system_prompt": SYSTEM,
    "test_variables": {"customer_id": "c_test", "first_name": "Dana", "last_name": "Fisher", "title": "Ms", "now": "2026-10-14T11:00"},
    "global_nodes": {},
    "nodes": {
        "setup": code_node("setup", SETUP_CODE, "greet"),
        "greet": greet, "third_party": third_party, "identity": identity,
        "fetch_account": fetch_account,
        "account": code_node("account", ACCOUNT_CODE, "collect"),
        "collect": collect, "record": record, "end": end,
    },
}

with open(os.path.join(OUT, "brief-b.workflow.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(wf, f, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
print("written")

content.text:
I built and saved the brief-b phone agent (version 4). The last practice run passed 1 of the 3 Brief B customers. I made fixes after that run, but they are untested because the tool blocked a third run (two practice runs per build is the limit).

**Checks:** the lint has no errors or warnings, validation passes, and the one chat turn spoke the correct opening line with the name filled in: "Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Ms Fisher?"

**Practice runs (one run per customer each time, not the three the scoring uses):**
- **Run 1, 2 of 3:** PUB-11 and PUB-13 passed. PUB-12 failed: the agent recorded the credit-card promise without reading it back, and noted the two refused loans without making the persuasion attempts the brief requires.
- **Fix:** I split the payment talk into two parts. The first part can't record anything; it makes the attempts and reads all promises back together. The second part, which records promises and notes, starts only after the customer confirms the read-back or every product has ended without a promise.
- **Run 2, 1 of 3:** PUB-13 passed. In PUB-12 the attempts and read-back were now correct, but the agent sent the same promise twice. The bank refused the second one ("already has a promise"), so the agent wrongly noted the card as a recording failure and closed as no promise. PUB-11 failed the same way.
- **Fix after run 2:** the second part now opens with a fixed line ("Thank you. One moment please.") instead of a line the model writes, and an "already has a promise" reply now counts as recorded. This should stop the duplicate and the false failure note.

The files are in `out/`: `brief-b.spec.md`, the two code snippets, `brief-b_build.py`, `brief-b.workflow.json` and `brief-b.export.json`. The Slack connector also needs authorising in your claude.ai connector settings; it wasn't needed for this build.
